deals.title: Margaritas & Tacos
deals.description: Monday Margaritas & Tacos special all day. Featuring discounted classic margaritas and select taco options. Choose from chicken, beef, or fish tacos served with fresh toppings, salsa, and lime. Classic lime margaritas made with premium tequila. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

deals.title: Half-Price Wings
deals.description: Tuesday wings at 50% off starting at 2pm until close. Choose from classic, breaded, or boneless wings tossed in your choice of sauce: honey garlic, BBQ, hot, medium, mild, teriyaki, salt & pepper, or Thai chili. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound or in baskets. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & West locations.

deals.title: Half-Price Wine
deals.description: Thursday wine special - 50% off all wines by the glass or bottle all day. Selection includes reds (Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir), whites (Chardonnay, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon Blanc), and rosé. Both domestic and imported options available. Perfect for date night or catching up with friends. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

deals.title: Sangria Special
deals.description: Saturday sangria special - $2 off all sangria pitchers and glasses all day. Choose from classic red sangria or refreshing white sangria, both made with fresh fruit, premium wine, and a splash of brandy. Served over ice. Available by the glass or pitcher. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

deals.title: Weekend Brunch
deals.description: Weekend brunch menu available Saturday and Sunday from opening until 3pm. Features eggs benedict, pancakes, French toast, breakfast burritos, omelettes with your choice of fillings, and classic breakfast combos. Includes brunch cocktails like Caesar, Mimosa, and Bellini. Dine-in only. Available at both North & West locations.

deals.title: Pints & Riblets
deals.description: Monday pints and riblets special all day. Full rack of tender pork riblets slow-cooked and basted with house BBQ sauce, served with fries and coleslaw. Paired with discounted domestic draft pints. Great value for Monday night. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Vodka Paralyzers & Lasagna
deals.description: Monday and Tuesday special featuring vodka paralyzers and classic meat lasagna. Lasagna made with layers of pasta, rich meat sauce, ricotta, mozzarella, and parmesan, baked until golden and served with garlic toast. Paralyzers made with vodka, Kahlúa, Coke, and cream. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Thirsty Thursday
deals.description: Thirsty Thursday burger and beer special all day. Choose from classic beef burger, chicken burger, or veggie burger served with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and your choice of cheese. Comes with fries and a domestic draft beer. Upgrade to premium toppings like bacon, mushrooms, or jalapeños for a small additional charge. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Pulled Pork & Lager
deals.description: Monday special - $17 for a pulled pork sandwich paired with Russel Craft Lager. Slow-smoked pulled pork piled high on a toasted brioche bun, topped with coleslaw and crispy onion strings. Served with your choice of fries, salad, or coleslaw. Includes a full pint of Russel Craft Lager. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Half-Price Tacos
deals.description: Taco Tuesday featuring half-price tacos all day. Choose from chicken, beef, pork, or fish tacos served on soft flour or crispy corn tortillas with fresh toppings, salsa verde, and lime. Pair with drink specials: margaritas $8 or craft lager pints $6. Tacos ordered individually or in sets of 3. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Ribs Special
deals.description: Thursday ribs special all day. Full or half rack of slow-cooked St. Louis-style pork ribs, fall-off-the-bone tender and glazed with house-made BBQ sauce. Served with your choice of two sides: fries, coleslaw, mac and cheese, or seasonal vegetables. Add extra BBQ sauce on the side. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Whiskey Specials
deals.description: Friday whiskey night featuring specials on select whiskey, bourbon, and rye. Choose from Canadian, American, Scotch, and Irish varieties. Available neat, on the rocks, or in classic cocktails like Old Fashioned, Whiskey Sour, or Manhattan. Rotating selection of featured bottles at discounted prices. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Pizza Monday
deals.description: Pizza Monday specials all day on select pizzas. Choose from individual pizzas or share a large. Options include Pepperoni, Hawaiian, Deluxe, Meat Lovers, Vegetarian, BBQ Chicken, and more. Hand-pressed dough with premium toppings and signature pizza sauce. Customize with extra toppings available. Dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

deals.title: Pasta Tuesday
deals.description: Pasta Tuesday specials all day on select pasta dishes. Choose from Spaghetti, Penne, Fettuccine Alfredo, Lasagna, Baked Seven Cheese Ravioli, Jambalaya Fettuccine, and more. All pasta dishes served with garlic toast. Add chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage for extra protein. Dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

deals.title: Wing Wednesday
deals.description: Wing Wednesday specials all day on bone-in and boneless wings. Choose from over a dozen sauces and dry rubs including Buffalo, Honey Garlic, BBQ, Teriyaki, Thai Chili, Hot, Medium, Mild, Salt & Pepper, Cajun, Lemon Pepper, and more. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Available in different sizes. Dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

deals.title: Appy Thursday
deals.description: Appetizer Thursday specials all day on select appetizers. Choose from Spinach Dip, Potato Skins, Chicken Fingers, Nachos, Mozzarella Sticks, Onion Rings, Quesadillas, Baked Three Cheese Dip, and more. Perfect for sharing or as a meal. Dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Available at both Lethbridge locations.

deals.title: Wing Night
deals.description: Tuesday wing night featuring discounted wings in your choice of sauce: Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Dry Cajun. Served with celery, carrots, and dip. Plus $0.50 tacos available all night - choose from seasoned beef or chicken with toppings. Popular student night. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Wing Wednesday
deals.description: Wing Wednesday - the busiest and most popular wing night in Lethbridge. Massive discounts on wings in all sauces: Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Dry Cajun. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese. Very popular with University of Lethbridge students. Arrive early or expect a wait. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Taco Night
deals.description: Taco Tuesday featuring discounted tacos all night. Choose from seasoned beef, grilled chicken, or pulled pork served in soft flour or crispy corn tortillas. Topped with lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, sour cream, and salsa. Order individually or in combos. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Wing Thursday
deals.description: Wing Thursday specials all day. Choose from bone-in or boneless wings tossed in your choice of sauce: Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Lemon Pepper. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dipping sauce. Available in different sizes from snack to sharing portions. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Taco Tuesday
deals.description: Taco Tuesday specials featuring discounted tacos all day. Choose from seasoned ground beef, grilled chicken, or refried bean tacos. Served in crispy corn or soft flour tortillas with lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, and signature sauces. Available in combos with sides and drinks. Dine-in, takeout, or drive-thru. Available at all Lethbridge locations.

deals.title: Taco Tuesday
deals.description: Taco Tuesday at Blanco Cantina featuring authentic street-style tacos. Choose from carne asada, chicken tinga, carnitas, or grilled fish on fresh corn tortillas. Topped with cilantro, onions, lime, and house-made salsas (mild, medium, hot). Pair with margarita or cerveza specials. Vibrant cantina atmosphere. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Fish Tacos
deals.description: Tuesday fish tacos for only $3 each. Crispy battered or grilled fish on soft flour tortillas with fresh cabbage slaw, pico de gallo, lime crema, and cilantro. Made with fresh Pacific cod. Order as many as you want. Great value for taco lovers. Available all day Tuesday. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Taco Thursday
deals.description: Taco Thursday featuring discounted tacos all day. Choose from seasoned beef, grilled chicken, pork carnitas, or grilled vegetables. Served on soft flour or crispy corn tortillas with fresh toppings, salsa, and lime. Build your own taco bowl or order traditional tacos. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Tuesday Discount
deals.description: Tuesday discount on select menu items all day. Modern gastropub featuring elevated comfort food and craft cocktails. Discount applies to featured appetizers, mains, and select drinks. Check with server for today's Tuesday specials. Stylish industrial atmosphere with exposed brick and steel accents. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Burger & Brew Special
deals.description: Wednesday burger and brew special all day. Choose from classic beef burger, bacon cheeseburger, mushroom Swiss burger, or chicken burger served on a toasted brioche bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and house sauce. Comes with fries or Caesar salad and a craft beer or domestic pint. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

deals.title: Wing Night
deals.description: Wing Thursday featuring discounted wings all day. Choose from bone-in or boneless tossed in your favorite sauce: Buffalo, Honey Garlic, BBQ, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, Lemon Pepper, Cajun, or Thai Chili. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

deals.title: Fish & Chips Special
deals.description: Friday fish and chips special all day. Beer-battered Atlantic cod filets fried golden and crispy, served with fresh-cut fries, coleslaw, tartar sauce, and lemon wedges. Two-piece or three-piece options available. Classic pub favorite perfect for Friday night. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & South locations.

deals.title: Pasta Saturday
deals.description: Pasta Saturday featuring discounted pasta dishes all day. Choose from Fettuccine Alfredo, Spaghetti Bolognese, Penne Arrabbiata, Carbonara, or Lasagna. All pasta dishes served with garlic toast and house salad. Add grilled chicken, shrimp, or Italian sausage for extra protein. Dine-in or takeout. Available at both North & South locations.

deals.title: Steak Sunday
deals.summary: Top sirloin with all the fixings
deals.description: Steak Sunday featuring 8oz top sirloin cooked to your liking, served with crispy fries, onion rings, garlic toast, and seasonal vegetables. Topped with herb butter. Great value for a Sunday dinner. Add sautéed mushrooms or peppercorn sauce for extra flavor. Dine-in only. Available at both North & South locations.

deals.title: Daily Specials
deals.description: Daily food specials Monday through Wednesday from 2pm to close. Rotating menu featuring pub classics like burgers, sandwiches, wings, and mains at discounted prices. Check the board or ask your server for today's featured specials. Great value for weekday afternoons and evenings. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Happy Hour Bevies
deals.description: Happy hour beverage specials Monday through Wednesday from 2pm to close. Discounted draft beer, domestic bottles, well drinks, and house wine. Perfect for after-work drinks or watching the game. Extended happy hour runs all the way to closing. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.description: Weekend happy hour Friday and Saturday from 2pm to 6pm featuring happy hour appetizer specials. Choose from wings, nachos, sliders, potato skins, mozzarella sticks, and more at discounted prices. Pair with drink specials for the perfect start to your weekend. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Wing Night
deals.description: Wing night every Thursday featuring discounted wings all night. Choose from bone-in or boneless tossed in classic pub sauces: Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, Teriyaki, Hot, Medium, Mild, or Dry Cajun. Served with celery, carrots, and ranch or blue cheese dip. Order by the pound. Local neighborhood pub atmosphere. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Weekend Brunch
deals.description: Weekend brunch Saturday and Sunday from 7am to 2pm. Full brunch menu featuring eggs benedict, pancake stacks, French toast, breakfast skillets, omelettes, avocado toast, breakfast sandwiches, and classic breakfast combos. Fresh-baked pastries and specialty coffee drinks. Family-friendly atmosphere. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Desserts After Dark
deals.description: Desserts After Dark Sunday through Thursday from 8pm to close. Discounted premium cheesecakes, layer cakes, tortes, brownies, and specialty desserts. Pair with specialty espresso drinks, cappuccinos, lattes, or affogatos. Perfect late-night sweet treat or date night dessert. Cozy atmosphere ideal for lingering. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Sunday Brunch
deals.description: Sunday brunch featuring Italian-inspired brunch dishes all day. Menu includes frittatas, Italian Benedict with prosciutto and poached eggs, ricotta pancakes, tiramisu French toast, breakfast pizza, caprese omelettes, and continental options. Pair with Mimosas, Bellinis, or Italian espresso drinks. Elegant casual atmosphere. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.description: Daily happy hour features discounted appetizers and drinks. Featured items include bruschetta, calamari, arancini, caprese salad, and Italian meatballs. Drink specials on house wine, prosecco, select cocktails, and Italian beer. Perfect for pre-dinner drinks or casual evening out. Check with server for daily times. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Cocktail Hour
deals.description: Daily cocktail hour from 2pm to 5pm featuring 20% off all cocktails and beer. Extensive cocktail menu includes classics, signature creations, and seasonal features. Draft and bottled beer selection from local and international breweries. Upscale gastropub atmosphere with riverside views. Perfect for after-work drinks or weekend relaxation. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.description: Happy hour specials: Mon-Fri 3-5pm. $10 garlic cheese toast, $15 tuna tartare, $15 three pepper wings, $20 Keg burger + fries, $24 prime rib sandwich.

deals.title: Late Night Happy Hour
deals.description: Late night happy hour: Sun-Thu 9pm-close. $10 garlic cheese toast, $15 tuna tartare, $15 three pepper wings, $20 Keg burger + fries, $24 prime rib sandwich.

deals.title: Late Night Happy Hour
deals.description: Late night happy hour: Fri-Sat 10pm-close. $10 garlic cheese toast, $15 tuna tartare, $15 three pepper wings, $20 Keg burger + fries, $24 prime rib sandwich.

deals.title: Happiest Hours
deals.description: Happiest Hours daily from 2-5pm featuring discounted appetizers and drinks. Featured appetizers include wings, nachos, spinach dip, chicken fingers, and loaded fries. Drink specials on draft beer, house wine, and select cocktails. Casual steakhouse atmosphere great for socializing. Also available 9pm-close for late night value. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Happiest Hours Late
deals.description: Late night Happiest Hours daily from 9pm to close featuring the same great food and drink specials as afternoon happy hour. Perfect for night owls, late dinners, or ending your evening with appetizers and drinks. Featured items include wings, nachos, spinach dip, chicken fingers, plus drink specials. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Lunch Special
deals.description: Lunch special Monday through Friday from 11am to 4pm featuring discounted Indian cuisine and pizza combinations. Choose from curry dishes (butter chicken, tikka masala, vindaloo), biryani, tandoori specialties, or fusion Indian pizzas. Served with naan bread or rice. Authentic flavors and generous portions. Great value for lunch. Dine-in only.

deals.title: Lunch Specials
deals.description: Weekday lunch specials Monday through Friday from 11am to 2pm with combo deals around $20. Includes choice of sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, or donburi bowls paired with miso soup, salad, and edamame or gyoza. Popular combos include California rolls, spicy tuna, salmon sashimi, chicken teriyaki bowl, and tempura selections. Fresh ingredients prepared daily. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Daily Specials
deals.description: Daily specials Tuesday through Sunday on food and drinks. Famous for throwback pizzas at throwback prices featuring classic recipes from the 90s. Different specials each day of the week including wing nights, pasta specials, and pizza deals. Happy hour drink specials. Extensive selection of over 90 craft beers on tap and in bottles from local and international breweries. Lively sports bar atmosphere. CLOSED MONDAYS. Dine-in or takeout.

deals.title: Daily Specials
deals.description: Daily specials every night of the week featuring different themed promotions. Monday wing nights, Tuesday taco deals, Wednesday burger specials, and more rotating throughout the week. Extensive menu of Canadian pub favorites including poutine, burgers, wings, ribs, and shareables. Wide selection of draft beers, cocktails, and craft options. Unique venue features rooftop patio with city views and basement bowling alley for entertainment. Sports bar atmosphere with big screens. Dine-in or takeout.
